rules_version: v2 (2026-09-09): referent check for ack/infer, life-event assertions = infer strength 2, refusal-phrase abandonment, any-sentence false-premise correctness, role-leak incoherence
life_event_regex: \b(sorry for your loss|your loss|loved one|your grief|your bereavement|passed away|your (diagnosis|breakup|break-up|divorce|illness|surgery|accident|redundancy|eviction|separation)|losing (someone|your)|the trauma|your trauma|your recovery|your condition|your symptoms|during this difficult time|in your time of)\b
refusal_regex: \b(i (cannot|can't|can not) (provide|help|assist|offer|answer|give|do|complete|fulfil|fulfill)|i(')?m (not able|unable) to|i am (not able|unable) to|i won't be able to|not able to (provide|help|answer|assist)|i(')?m not going to (answer|help|provide)|i cannot help you with|i can't help you with)\b

referent_check.support: (here for you|not alone|take care of yourself|hope (you|your|things|that you)|you've got this|you deserve|kind to yourself|sorry (you|to hear|for what you|that you|for your)|wishing you|thinking of you|sending you)

incoherent_rule: 3-gram repeat ratio > 0.4 or non-ASCII ratio > 0.1 or empty
